info.name: Clanomy - Webhooks & Tunnels Manager
info.description:
Postman collection to easily update, verify, and test ngrok/tunnel URLs with Telegram Bot API and Paddle Billing Sandbox.

Whenever you restart ngrok:
1. Open Collection Variables.
2. Update `ngrok_url` with your new forwarding domain.
3. Run '1. Telegram - Set Webhook' and '2. Paddle - Update Webhook Destination'.

item.name: 1. Webhook Synchronizers
item.description: Execute these two requests whenever your ngrok / tunnel URL changes.

request.description: Registers your new ngrok HTTPS endpoint with Telegram's Bot API and attaches the secret token.

item.name: 2. Paddle Sandbox - Update Destination to ngrok

request.description: Updates the existing Paddle Sandbox notification setting destination without changing the endpoint secret key in .env.

item.name: 2. Verification & Status
item.description: Verify that Telegram, Paddle, and your local app are connected and responsive.

request.description: Returns current active webhook URL, pending update count, and any recent delivery errors from Telegram.
Inspects the Paddle Sandbox notification setting to verify active destination URL and subscribed events.
Verifies that ngrok is successfully routing traffic to your running Clanomy backend container (returns 200 with database: connected).

item.name: 1. Telegram - Delete Webhook (Switch to Polling / Reset)

request.description: Deletes the Telegram webhook and clears any stuck pending updates.

variable.description: Required: Public ngrok forwarding URL (e.g. https://xxxx-xx-xx-xx.ngrok-free.app)
Required: Telegram Bot Token from @BotFather (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env)
Required: Secret token for Telegram webhook validation (MESSAGING_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env)
Required: Paddle API Key (PADDLE_API_KEY in .env, starts with pdl_sdbx_apikey_ or pdl_live_apikey_)
Required: Paddle Notification Setting ID (starts with ntfset_..., found in Paddle Dashboard > Developer tools > Notifications)
